# Spinner: `jl-spinner`

A turning ring for work in progress.

- Class `JlSpinner`, an atom: `import { JlSpinner } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/spinner

For work that takes a moment and has no measurable progress. When the progress is known, a progress bar
says more. The spinner follows the text colour and has the status role, so screen readers hear its label.

## Use

```ts
import { JlSpinner } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlSpinner size={24} />
```

```html
<jl-spinner size="24"></jl-spinner>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `size` (attribute `size`): `number`, default `16`. Width and height, in pixels.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. What screen readers say. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Sizes

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-spinner size="12"></jl-spinner>
  <jl-spinner></jl-spinner>
  <jl-spinner size="24"></jl-spinner>
  <jl-spinner size="36"></jl-spinner>
</div>
```

### With text, and coloured

```html
<div class="row">
  <span class="row muted" style="gap: 8px"><jl-spinner></jl-spinner> Loading your projects…</span>
  <jl-spinner style="color: var(--jl-accent)" size="20"></jl-spinner>
</div>
```
